events.feedback:
This is a good entry structurally, but I would make a few fairly substantial edits before calling it production-ready. The **best material is already here**; the main issue is that a handful of claims are stronger than the evidence appears to support, and some wording is more dramatic than the calm, matter-of-fact voice you're after.

I’m leaving the iNaturalist botanical name completely untouched.

## Quick Hits

The first two are excellent concepts. I'd keep the black fruit and the “bitten” leaflet tip at the top because they're things visitors can actually see.

I would change Quick Hit #1 slightly:

I like this better than “instantly recognizable,” which is a little absolute.
